decision_reason: Remembered-role apply denied because an earlier successful event had already consumed this exact joined policy decision instance before reconcile retried the same mutation.
notes: No observed_binding is emitted here: policy-consumed wins before compare-and-swap, the denial points at the earlier successful consuming event, consumed_by_event_digest binds the canonical bytes of that winner for offline verification, consuming_event_action = updated makes the winner shape queryable as evidence-only summary data without reopening the winner event body, consumed_binding_digest carries the resulting binding.digest from that earlier success as evidence-only summary data, consumed_diff_digest carries the earlier winner's reviewed diff.digest as evidence-only summary data, consumed_previous_binding_digest carries the earlier winner's replaced previous_binding.digest as evidence-only summary data for updated winners, and recovery_interpretation = already-applied means that same exact mutation retry may be surfaced as already-applied once that consuming event is joined and matches the tuple, and a spent decision instance does not later decay into policy-expired just because the apply window also elapsed.
